entries.head: logql
entries.message: logql: variants(...) has no variant arms
entries.rationale: the LogQL grammar (metricExprs) requires at least one variant arm inside `variants(...)`; a zero-arm MultiVariantExpr is unreachable from the pinned parser

entries.head: logql
entries.message: logql: variant %d is not an Expr (%T)
entries.rationale: every SampleExpr the parser stores in MultiVariantExpr.Variants() also satisfies syntax.Expr; the type assertion is a defensive guard the pinned parser never trips

entries.head: logql
entries.rationale: wraps the per-arm lowering error of an inner SampleExpr — the underlying failure is catalogued at its own lowering site, so this wrapper adds no new wire-reachable rejection
